messages:
mike_rust: FYI ran a local hit test with the rust sampleapp (prefetch=6, concurrency=20) and forcing token rotate produced a synchronized retry spike and a bunch of 429s. anyone familiar with token refresh semantics in rust sdk?
zoe_qe: yeah we saw a CI flake like that. do you have the sequence? sounds like backoff state resets during refresh.
mike_rust: sequence: requests hit 401, client starts refresh, all tasks await, then when refresh completes many immediately retry. logs: 
```
[2026-03-25T11:44:33Z] req=1 status=401
[2026-03-25T11:44:33Z] refresh:start
[2026-03-25T11:44:38Z] refresh:done
[2026-03-25T11:44:38Z] req=1 retry
[2026-03-25T11:44:38Z] req=2 retry
... -> 429s
```
sam_sdk: quick analysis: rust client holds a global async Mutex during refresh so all inflight tasks block and then retry at once. go/js implemented a single-winner refresh future; others just await it and preserve per-request backoff.
jena_docs: sampleapp prefetcher certainly magnifies this, it spawns next-page fetches immediately when slots free. blocked workers wake simultaneously. we should change sampleapp defaults and doc guidance.
ops_alan: this could impact hosted customers if many clients rotate keys at same time. suggest: narrow lock, implement refresh-future, add jittered retry in prefetcher, and respect Retry-After header.
mike_rust: patch plan: (1) fast-path expiry check outside lock, (2) winner does refresh under lock, others await a shared future, (3) do not reset per-request backoff on refresh, (4) sampleapp defaults prefetch=2 and add jitter 40-180ms. I'll open PR.
sam_sdk: please add unit/CI stress tests that simulate N clients expiring simultaneously and assert no >2x spike at 95th.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created PR #4901 (rust-sdk) and scheduled staging run for 2026-03-25T22:00Z.
jena_docs: i'll add "safe prefetch" note to quickstart and a diagnostic flag to the sampleapp to simulate token expiry.
mike_rust: thanks all — ping me for validation after staging canary.
